shortDescription: Management of OS templates in Proxmox VE cluster

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: checksum
options.description: The checksum to validate against. Checksums are often provided by software distributors to verify that a download is not corrupted. Checksums can usually be found on the distributors download page in the form of a file or string. If specified, O(checksum_algorithm) must also be specified.

options.name: checksum_algorithm
options.description: Algorithm used to verify the checksum. If specified, O(checksum) must also be specified.

options.name: content_type
options.description: Content type of the template. Valid values are V(vztmpl) for LXC container templates, V(iso) for ISO disc images, and V(import) for harddisk images and Open Virtual Appliances (OVA).

options.name: force
options.description: It can only be used with O(state=present), existing template will be overwritten.

options.name: node
options.description: Proxmox VE node on which to operate.

options.name: src
options.description: Path to uploaded file. Exactly one of O(src) or O(url) is required for O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the template.

options.name: storage
options.description: Target storage.

options.name: template
options.description: The template name. Required for O(state=absent) to delete a template. Required for O(state=present) to download an appliance container template (pveam).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout for operations.

options.name: url
options.description: URL to file to download. Exactly one of O(src) or O(url) is required for O(state=present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).
